name: genpark-multi-agent-resource-deadlock-wait-for-graph-resolver-skill
description: Multi-Agent Resource Lock & Wait-For Graph (WFG) Deadlock Resolver. Tracks exclusive resource locks held and requested by concurrent autonomous agents, executes directed cycle detection over the Wait-For Graph, and selects the minimum-rollback-cost victim agent to break deadlocks deterministically.

tools.name: resolve_multi_agent_deadlock
tools.description: Construct Wait-For Graph from agent lock allocations, detect circular wait cycles, and preempt minimum-cost victim agent.

agent_states.description: List of agents [agent_id, holds_resources, waits_for_resource, rollback_cost_score].
